prompt:
Generate a fresh, high-quality Korean reservation-summary UI entirely from this text brief. Keep a clean editorial two-column composition, but match the visual system of the existing TripLOG app. Target 390 × 250 logical pixels for the whole component, with transport on the left and accommodation on the right.

Use the app’s actual design tokens: white background, deep ink #0b1020, supporting gray #686b75, bright yellow #fff05a, pastel pink #f7afc7 and light blue #bce6fb. Use crisp 1.5-pixel ink outlines, restrained 9–10-pixel corner radii and tiny solid offset shadows only on the yellow actions or badges. Keep the main panel flat and clean. Use small black outline icons with subtle blue or pink accents. No red branding, physical texture, leather, decorative illustrations or soft 3D effects.

Preserve the editorial structure: a small brand row, two equal content columns with a quiet central divider, clear category headers, concise summaries and aligned bottom actions. The brand row contains only a compact black “TRIPLOG” wordmark with a pink label behind “LOG”; no slogan or promotional copy. Keep this row small so the reservation information remains the focus.

Use sharp Korean Pretendard-style typography with optically aligned baselines: category headings around 15 pixels and bold, the route around 18 pixels, hotel names 13–14 pixels, and supporting dates 12 pixels. Counts are small yellow outlined badges. Emphasize the route and hotel names while keeping dates lighter. Use the exact content below:

Left column:
교통 예약
3건
서울 ↔ 오사카
제주항공
9.25–9.28
전체 보기

Right column:

9.25–9.26 · 1박
호텔 몬돈스…

전체 보기

Make each “전체 보기” action a compact yellow button with an ink outline and a right chevron, aligned to the same bottom baseline. Use a fine separator between the two hotel summaries. Keep both columns readable at mobile size without expanding individual flight records or adding extra information. Render a finished, carefully proportioned app component with crisp digital UI quality. No phone frame, browser chrome or external annotations. Current date is 2026-10-04; the displayed reservation dates are in September 2026.
